analysis.title: Orbital Marketing Talent Landing Page
analysis.notes: A dark rounded hero panel sits within a lavender-to-peach atmospheric background, pairing a large multiline headline with an orbital network of avatars and floating tiles. The visual direction combines premium SaaS polish with playful spatial depth, luminous gradients, and restrained monochrome navigation details.
analysis.heroPrompt: Create an abstract futuristic network visualization on a deep indigo-to-violet background: several concentric elliptical orbit lines surround a central glowing metric point, with diverse circular profile portraits and small floating rounded-square interface tiles positioned along the paths. Add subtle neon violet highlights, soft bloom, gentle depth, and a premium SaaS art direction. Keep the composition weighted to the right with generous negative space on the left for headline text. No logos, brand names, or readable text.
